scenario.title: The Drowned Road
scenario.premise: The causeway to Saint Ferrant only opens for four hours either side of low water, and the tide bell at the Bell House counts down the crossing. Kael has reached the Bell House with the water already rising, and something that used to be a person is still out on the flats.

scene.title: The Bell House
scene.question: Can Kael get out of the Bell House and onto the causeway before Ovid rings the third bell?
scene.situation: The Bell House stands at the causeway's landward end, its rope still swinging from the second peal. Ovid Sarn watches the flats through a cracked window while Ivo Casks paces by the door, and out past the mudflats the chapel lamp waits a mile off across water already climbing your boots.
scene.secret: Ovid rings the bell twice to mark the crossing window, never as a call for help; a third ring means something is already out on the causeway.

world.source:
# The Drowned Road

The causeway to Saint Ferrant runs three miles over tidal flats and is walkable
for four hours either side of low water.

> The bell rings twice. The water is already over your boots, and the chapel
> lamp is still a mile off.

The Bell House stands at the causeway's landward end. Its keeper, Ovid Sarn,
rings the tide bell twice a day.

p. 3

ovid-sarn.name: Ovid Sarn
ovid-sarn.brief: The Bell House's keeper, who rings the tide bell twice a day and reads the flats better than anyone left alive.

ivo-casks.name: Ivo Casks
ivo-casks.brief: A supply runner pinned here by the tide, itching to make the crossing before the flats fill up with Crawlers.

drowned-marta.name: Drowned Marta
drowned-marta.brief: Once the causeway's toll-keeper, now a Crawler that answers the bell the same as anyone still starving.

player.name: Kael
player.brief: A scarred relic-hunter who comes wherever something old lies sealed, and does not leave it shut.
